subject.title: fix: recover stranded replies in message_tool_only mode (#85714)

question: Should #85714 recovery ship as #88992's default-off `messages.strandedReplyRecovery` flag, as #99536's default-on guarded recovery without a new config surface, or remain warning-only?
rationale: Both open PRs change the `message_tool_only` privacy and delivery contract in different ways, and that policy choice cannot be safely inferred from tests alone.

options.title: Accept opt-in recovery after live proof
options.body: Merge #88992's default-off config shape only after maintainers approve the new flag and receive redacted real Telegram/Teams-style proof for one stranded-final recovery with no duplicate retry.

options.title: Use the default-on successor
options.body: Pause or close #88992 and resolve #99536 if maintainers prefer recovery by default and no new `messages.strandedReplyRecovery` config surface.

options.title: Keep warning-only behavior
options.body: Close both recovery PRs if maintainers want `message_tool_only` to remain strictly private unless the agent itself calls `message(action=send)`.

recommendation.title: Accept opt-in recovery after live proof
recommendation.body: Merge #88992's default-off config shape only after maintainers approve the new flag and receive redacted real Telegram/Teams-style proof for one stranded-final recovery with no duplicate retry.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows repeated adjacent work on auto-reply delivery, config/docs, and queue behavior, making this the best available routing owner for the policy decision.
